evidenceScope: Gait quality measurements only; no full physical qualification implied.

walkingForwardCOMSpeed.definition: abs(measured COM velocity dot fixed initial heading) < 0.005 m/s; transfer/lift/translate/land/settle rows after arm placement, before terminal stand

travel.ownFootAdvanceDefinition: Each swing foot from its own measured step-entry origin, not separation beyond the stance foot.

capture.definition: Signed distances to recorded current-support convex hull; capture = COMxy + COMvelocityxy*sqrt(COMz/9.81). Undefined is failure, never excluded from pass.

archivedReference.evidenceLimit: Archived compact measurements only; lost journal metrics cannot be recomputed.
archivedReference.completionIntervalsDefinition: Completion may include settle and final quiet; not loaded-landing cadence.
